why: Vejr with location denied (signed out): the location's name (the app's title node) is empty, so the screen has no title. The arrows the app draws at the sides of its page, with no words of their own, are named Forrige lokation and Næste lokation where they stand, in the secondary tone, outlined as the app draws them (no fill), each at its own width on the line they share. Search, graphs and the favourite switch are the app's top bar, as it draws them over its page: søg at its start, grafer and the switch at its end, the switch keeping its state. The bottom navigation as tabs with Relaid's icons (no sun, map or warning in its set: home, grid, chart, bell, settings).
shows: Slå lokalisering til for at se nærmeste lokationer

why: Målinger (a Compose screen, no ids but the tabs', told apart by its selected tab): the title in the bar at its start, as the app draws it in its header band. The search field is named by the words the app shows in it (Søg lokation), never by the English description its icon and the whole field give (Search), which the view hides (it would name no field over the words drawn in it all the same) and which shows nowhere. The two lines about the location the owner has not shared are centred, as the app centres them (a recapture with where its texts' words sit). Nothing stands side by side.
title: Målinger

why: Varsler with no warnings: the title in the bar, larger than the body as the app draws it. INGEN VARSLER, the app's small capitals over its text, is a heading. The app's info icon at the end of its bar, beside its title on a screen with no toolbar, list or page, sits at the end of the bar as an option the bar draws.
title: Varsler
shows: Her vises alle aktuelle vejrvarsler for regioner og kommuner i Danmark.

why: Indstillinger: the app's rows with a chevron each (Buttons in a scroll view that does not scroll) as the screen's list, so each is an item to open, as the app draws them, not a button. OM APP'EN, the app's small capitals between them, is a heading, the title not taken from it. The version centred under the rows, as the app draws it (a recapture with where its texts' words sit).
title: Indstillinger
